reviews.text:
I want to give a very special thank you to Joana and Fernando for the affection, dedication, and care they give Prada her baths. ❤️🐶
It's clear that they do their work with a lot of love and professionalism, always treating her so well and leaving us with complete confidence and peace of mind. It's so good to know she's in good hands! I wholeheartedly recommend their services to anyone looking for trustworthy, attentive people who truly love animals. Thank you so much for all the love you give our Prada! 🥰🐾❤️
Great, Mel is very anxious but she has a lot of patience and affection.
A new experience for our dog, and the result was incredible, from the transportation service and bath to the ease of contact! Friendly and professional!!
Fab owners who are very attentive at all levels. They do a lovely job at a very fair price. Very happy. Always on our To Do list when in Porto.

There are no adjectives to express my gratitude; my Bony 💞 unconditionally loves the owners of Dogsclub.
Attentive, kind, lovely people.
As for Bony's owners, a huge thank you for everything!

Sincerely

I highly recommend them! The owners are super attentive, they accommodated our girls in an exceptional situation, always responded quickly to messages, and upon arrival they greeted us so warmly and kindly. And as for the wonderful bath and grooming, I have two Border Collies and I haven't seen their coats so shiny and silky in a long time. When we picked them up, you could tell how comfortable they were there. Great pet shop in Porto!!

I love Dogs Club! 🐾 They take care of my furry friends with so much love, attention, and professionalism. They are always happy when they go there and always come back well-treated, smelling great, and looking beautiful. You can really feel the love they have for animals. I wholeheartedly recommend them!”
Thank you Fernando and Joana for all the love and care you gave my boys 🐾🐾
Highly professional and very kind!

I took my son to the dogs club for the first time and I loved it and highly recommend it. I researched reliable places and this seemed the best option, and I was right. Their love for animals is evident; they always respected our requests. And they took excellent care of my son's fur. Furthermore, they alerted me to certain aspects of caring for my son that I hadn't yet considered. I am very grateful for that. I highly recommend them!
Excellent service, my dog ​​enjoyed the baths and grooming, I was very happy.
Spectacular, attentive, and extremely professional. We loved the experience and will definitely be back; they deserve all the success! 🙏🏼 …

DogsClub Baths and Grooming in Matosinhos! I took my dog ​​Aoki and was truly impressed with the care, professionalism, and attention of the entire team.

Aoki returned home clean, smelling great, and clearly well-treated—you can tell when a dog is cared for with love 😊 Furthermore, the service was excellent, always available and very attentive to all his needs.

Without a doubt, a trustworthy place for anyone who wants the best for their furry friend. I highly recommend it!
I highly recommend it. My Pantufas, who is always so wary, behaved wonderfully. Which only proves that he felt at home.
Very satisfied with the pick-up, bathing, and delivery service! A caring and attentive team focused on the well-being of their direct client – ​​the animal! Well done!
I took my 5-month-old Shih Tzu for the first time and loved the result! I highly recommend it!
My senior dog can't do without DogsClub anymore! The team is super professional and full of kindness and attention to my old man!

Today I took my cat for a bath, out of necessity I confess, I was just another one who thought cats didn't like baths...

And I couldn't help but share how incredible the experience was...

We were received so well from the very first moment. They were super attentive, explained every step of what they were going to do, and Bela was treated with all the love and care in the world, like a princess!

She behaved super well — and I'm sure that's because she felt safe and pampered the whole time. It's so good to find professionals who truly love what they do and treat our furry friends as if they were their own.

Thank you so much for the care, dedication, and kindness!

I highly recommend Dogs Club, it was my Kiko's first bath experience, he looked beautiful... I loved it... thank you so much for all the care.
Next bath already scheduled..🙏🏼 …

I took my dog ​​Olivia to the groomer for her first bath and grooming today, and I loved it! Olivia is afraid of haircuts and blow-drying, but the experience with Joana went very well! At the end, Olivia jumped on her legs asking for cuddles! Joana was extremely careful, and Olivia left looking beautiful and smelling wonderful! I highly recommend her! 😊
Excellent work!

I'm very happy with my Pumba's grooming. From the service, which was super friendly and attentive, to the final result, everything was impeccable. Pumba looked beautiful, smelled great, and was well cared for. The care and professionalism are noticeable. I highly recommend them!
Professionalism, punctuality, friendliness, and the way they treated my Lucky (was remarkable)... Thank you! I will recommend them to other pet owners!!!

It was the first time our 6-month-old Ellie went to a bathing area and we were apprehensive, but everything went well. Ellie went from shy and anxious at first to exploratory and curious at the end. We recommend it 🙏 …
Excellent nail clipper for restless dogs.
Amazing, my daughter loved it and so did I ✨
Joana and Fernando are very attentive and patient. My furry friends' fur looks spectacular ❤️❤️ and they smell wonderful 🐶🐶 …

Storm loves a bath and some affection.

Thank you so much Joana and Fernando for the patience you always have with my big boy.

Merry Christmas 🎄
😘
My little dog used to be terrified of pet shops, but at Dogs Club it's different. She arrives smiling, wagging her tail, and is incredibly jealous of Joana.

My sincerest thanks to Fernando and Joana for the loving and very patient way they treated Max🐕‍🦺, who, in addition to being extremely anxious and spoiled, doesn't like baths, unlike usual, and to my pleasant surprise, with them, he behaved beautifully, and became even cuter and more charming with the little towel that Aunt Joana put on him at the end.😍
Excellent professionals, loving and dedicated!!🌟
Me and the 🐕‍🦺Recommend all DogsClub services 100%🍀
Care, attention, and affection for "our little four-legged daughter." I highly recommend it!!!
Everything was perfect. The service, care, and professionalism were outstanding. We will definitely return.
Excellent service!
Excellent service and customer care.

If I could, I would give more than 5 stars!
They took great care of our 4-month-old baby, even though it was her first experience, she felt super comfortable in the space. She also had the opportunity to socialize with other dogs, which was a very positive extra.
The service was impeccable! Always available, attentive and with incredible quality. She left with super silky fur and smelling wonderfully! I recommend it 100%!

It was the first professional bath for my two shepherds and the service couldn't have been better!
The friendliness, the time spent getting to know my furry friends upon arrival, understanding their temperament, the treats and playtime, it was all an experience to repeat. (Not to mention the lovely smell and soft fur they left with!)
Thank you!
Excellent service

Excellent service from a very professional and friendly team.
I will definitely return with my dog!
Impeccable service and professionalism! Highly recommend!!!

I took my dog ​​to Dogsclub and I simply loved it! 🐶✨ He came out looking BEAUTIFUL, smelling great, and all dolled up, worthy of a magazine cover! 😍
The service was impeccable from beginning to end, and even the transportation was trendy! 🚐💅 You can see that they treat pets with a lot of love and care.

I recommend them without hesitation! Theodoro already has his official pet spa ❤️🐾 My dog ​​doesn't like to pose for photos, but I tried, look at that round face, I loved it!
Excellent service! I'm a fan! They showed great care and affection for the dogs, and the staff were super friendly and professional! Congratulations!

Dogsclub is a truly loving place for our beautiful furry friends. They take care of our pets and us with great care and affection. It was a gift from fate to have found such a place where we can truly trust… I can only express my gratitude for the way they care for our animals at home; you are wonderful. Thank you 🙏🏼 …
The best bath for my Beckinha.

It was a very positive experience.
We were quite apprehensive because our dog is very timid, but Joana and Fernando were very patient and knew exactly what to do.
Joana quickly gained António's trust and everything went very well. 😊
We will definitely return, and I recommend them 100%, they were very kind and attentive.
Thank you for taking such good care of our dog 🤗
Very friendly

Impeccable service! My puppy (German Spitz) was treated with incredible care and dedication. They explained all the grooming needs and showed a level of professionalism that makes all the difference. You can tell they truly love animals! I 100% recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy place to pamper their furry friends.
Very professional service. Very satisfied! My furry friend looks even more handsome :)
Super friendly and attentive. From the care of my Meeko to its delivery to my home. It arrived smelling wonderful and with a really nice sticker. Very good value for money!

My animals and I love your work and your attention.
Thank you.

Joana and Fernando are two people passionate about animals. Anyone who goes to dogsClub with their furry friends can see that passion at first glance.
They welcome, care for, pamper, and do everything to make the moment more enjoyable for our animals, from beginning to end. We can rest assured because, in addition to being excellent professionals, they are incredible human beings.
There should be more people like this with this love for furry friends, who need us so much.
I'm so glad that your resilience, persistence, and great willpower led you to realize this dream.
This year, in addition to bathing and grooming, we used the petsitting service, and we can only thank you because our Caju is a very sensitive animal who hates being alone. Once again, you met our expectations.
Thank you so much 🙏🙏

5 Stars. You were very kind, my Doddy behaved very well and was very sweet.
I really loved it, I'll always go to your salon next time. Thank you so much 🫶🏼♥️ …

Excellent service, Joana and Fernando are super friendly and helpful, always taking extreme care of our dog! Although the dog was very nervous, they were very calm and in the end she was already enjoying her "spa time"! A place we will definitely return to! Thank you very much!

We loved the service from start to finish! One of my cats has a big trauma related to baths and grooming, which always worried me when I washed him, but this time they allowed me to stay and follow the whole process, which made me feel safer, but mainly it left my kitten much calmer, more relaxed and almost fearless! They treated my cats as if they were their own, with all the love, affection and patience that all animals deserve! I recommend everyone come to DogsClub and enjoy an unforgettable experience!
A big thank you to Joana and Fernando for all this affection!

Spectacular service, very careful and I will always repeat the experience!!!!!!
Thank you very much, it was Zeus's first bath, and it went spectacularly well.
I loved the professionalism 👍 I became a customer 💕 …

Five-star service with impeccable professionalism.

Information and qualified training for the performance of duties.
An excellent service.

5*

We will certainly be customers again
Thank you for the attention and care from the girls
I 100% recommend Dogsclub, my animals love it!

Excellent service.
I really liked it, my little one came back looking beautiful and smelling wonderful.
The team is careful with the animals and concerned with getting to know the animal as much as possible.

I loved it.
I recommend it.

I am very grateful to Joana and Fernando for the professionalism, dedication, and care with which they treated my girl. It was the first time I tried it and I loved everything! They did an excellent job. The cut was impeccable, just the right length, the fur is white, silky, well-hydrated, and without knots. Simply perfect! I recommend them 100%.
Good experience.
Spectacular service. Thank you for all the care.

Yesterday, I used Joana and Fernando's services for the first time, both for bathing and grooming, as well as for round-trip transportation. I confess I was a little worried that something might go wrong, especially since I had the experience of taking the same dog for bathing and grooming and having her returned to me "drugged."
What I have to say, without anyone asking me for anything at all, is that Joana and Fernando's work was excellent. She was delivered to my door very clean and groomed, perfumed, and had a little bow on her head. Most importantly for me, she arrived serene and in a good mood.
Thank you, Joana and Fernando, for the care and respect you showed my Bichon Maltese "Su." I became your client, and you deserve my admiration for the honest and responsible way you treated me and all the care you showed my dear Su. Well done, may you have much success, because people like you deserve to have their work publicized and recommended. Thank you very much! Cristina Mourão.

Today, for the first time, my furry friend tried out their bathing and grooming services. I can tell you that it was the first time he came from such a calm and relaxed place.
They treat the animals very well, Xico came back smelling great, very well groomed, and most importantly, happy 🙂
I became a customer and I recommend them 100%.
I took my dog ​​to DogsClub and I couldn't be happier with the service! They were super professional, attentive, and very careful with my furry friend. I recommend them :)

Excellent work, I recommend them, very friendly and an excellent organization.

Thank you very much.
Impeccable service!
Excellent service 😁 very friendly and helpful …

I loved the service and care they gave my Bento. From picking him up at home, during his bath, and upon his return. They were always very helpful and attentive. You've gained a customer ❤️
I highly recommend it. A place where animals are treated with as much love as you can imagine ❤️

Incredible experience. Super attentive, very caring for the animals. Very friendly.

Wonderful work.

My girl's fur was super soft.
I loved it and my girl did too.
I will definitely be back.

They are 5 stars 🤩 and very professional and excellent.
Thank you. …

Excellent experience at my Westie's first grooming session. Friendly and attentive service to both the human customer and the furry friend! ❤️ Molly loved the complimentary scarf.
It's easy to park nearby, and there are chairs in the shop to wait for the service to finish. We've become regular customers!
Professional and extremely careful with our "boys"!
They love it!! They always go together happy and come back even happier!!

5-star service.
My dog ​​is extremely difficult to dry, but Fernando and Joana managed it with great care and affection.

Thank you!

Joana and Fernando are the people I trust most to leave my little one with; they are incredible and super loving.
I recommend them.

I am extremely satisfied with Joana and Fernando's work! Their service and empathy were excellent, both for me and my pets. They proved to be excellent professionals and, above all, excellent people. I really enjoyed it and will definitely return.
Excellent service, no problems whatsoever, the dog was spotless and smelled great 😁 …
The ideal place for our best four-legged friends. Professional and, above all, super friendly and kind. Ice wouldn't trade them for anything 😍❤️🐶 …

Top-notch!!! Super friendly owners, welcoming space, super professional staff, very affordable prices, and my furry friends left looking impeccable and completely happy! I highly recommend it, I'll be back! 🫶 …

The best experience we could have had with our Oliver. They explained everything perfectly, he looked absolutely gorgeous, excellent work.
I'm not giving it 5 stars, I'm giving it 10!!

Excellent professionals, they truly love what they do and you can see the care they give to all the animals! I recommend them 100%!
